claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Alprenolol is a beta-adrenergic antagonist that at 2.5 uM is expected to be largely inactive as a cytotoxic agent, with any antiproliferative effect likely reflecting weak, non-selective beta-blocker/off-target activity rather than a potent killing mechanism.
